Entries.spring_Mon: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Leo is such a sweet kid. I get a positive energy from him.$h
Entries.spring_Tues: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I'm glad that sweet little Leo comes to visit. I love listening to the two of them talk back and forth.  I think I'm learning their language!$h
Entries.spring_Wed: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Leo gave me a mango yesterday when he visited. He has an aura of joy.$h
Entries.spring_Thu: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Thank you for helping fix Willy's boat. The parrot is much happier with his friend Leo here.$h
Entries.spring_Fri: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#It must've been destiny that led Leo to talk to me that day. I really enjoy when he comes to visit.$h
Entries.spring_Sat: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Thank you for helping Leo learn to trust humans.
Entries.spring_Sun: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#My parrot seems a lot happier now that Leo comes to visit.$h
Entries.summer_Mon: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#It's so warm here. Nothing like the island, I'm sure. Leo says it's always so hot there.$h
Entries.summer_Tues: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Leo said there are so many parrots on the island.  Did you get to see them?
Entries.fall_Wed: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I wonder if the leaves change colors on the island?  I'll have to ask Leo.
Entries.fall_Thu: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#It's almost time to wear our cold weather clothes!  Oh, I hope Leo can stay warm.  It's such a different climate than he's used to.
Entries.winter_Sat: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I made Leo some winter clothes to keep him warm. Now I don't have to worry about him.$h
Entries.winter_Sun: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#The holidays are so much sweeter with that angel Leo coming around. He radiates pure white energy.$h

Entries.spring_Mon: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Miss Emily smiles at me all the time.  I like her a lot.$h
Entries.spring_Tues: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Miss Emily tries to talk like my family, but she's just making silly noises.$3
Entries.spring_Wed: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I gave Miss Emily a mango yesterday. She liked it.$h
Entries.spring_Thu: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I miss my island family, but my new human family is so nice to me.  Especially Miss Emily. She lets me visit my family as long as I want.$h
Entries.spring_Fri: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Thanks, @, for being my friend on the island.  I wouldn't have felt comfortable coming here without you being here. And I never would've found my missing parrot friend!$h
Entries.spring_Sat: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I'm glad we don't have school today.  I can go see my parrot family at Miss Emily's!$h
Entries.spring_Sun: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I can't visit Miss Emily's house today.  I have to study.$s
Entries.summer_Mon: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#It's warm outside, a lot like the island.$h
Entries.summer_Tues: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Mr. Linus said Miss Emily is a very nice lady and is taking good care of my parrot family.$h
Entries.fall_Wed: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Do you have any mango trees on your farm?
Entries.fall_Thu: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#I hope I don't get too cold this winter!  Brrrrr!
Entries.winter_Sat: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#It's cold here. It never gets cold on the island.
Entries.winter_Sun: $query PLAYER_HAS_SEEN_EVENT Current Br1ghtEy3s.Family#Miss Emily made me some warm clothes to wear. She's my family, too.$h
